propositions: Judging multiple candidates in one call reduces call count from 2N to 2*ceil(N/batch), removing redundant system prefix copies and lowering total input tokens by 48% versus pre-8415 baseline on measured corpus
Hoisting batch protocol description into system prompt grows cacheable prefix from 873 to 1,337 tokens, crossing the 1024-token minimum and enabling cache writes and reads that persist across calls
Batching verdict response requires label-matched demultiplexing instead of positional matching; missing or unknown batch entries must abstain only the affected candidate without affecting others

Per-pair relation verdicts shift on 6/12 ordered pairs when batching five candidates together, moving mostly conservative (related_distinct to unrelated), with all directional one-sided claims downgrades eliminated by both-orderings-agree rule
Batched judge must remain advisory; raising runners and malformed batch responses must surface empty result without exception propagation
